evidence.title: Prince Eduard of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: Eduard Karl Wilhelm Christian of Saxe- Altenburg( Hildburghausen, 3 July 1804 – Munich, 16 May 1852), was a German prince of the ducal house of Saxe- Hildburghausen( of Saxe- Altenburg from 1826).

evidence.title: Princess Charlotte of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: Princess Charlotte Agnes of Saxe- Altenburg( 4 March 189916 February 1989) was the eldest child of Ernst II, the last reigning duke of Saxe- Altenburg.

evidence.title: Princess Marie Anne of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: Princess Marie Anne of Saxe- Altenburg( 14 March 1864 – 3 May 1918) was the consort of Georg, Prince of Schaumburg- Lippe.

evidence.title: Princess Marie Anne of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: As the eldest daughter of Prince Moritz of Saxe- Altenburg and his wife Princess Augusta of Saxe- Meiningen, and a sister of Ernest II, Duke of Saxe- Altenburg, Marie Anne was a member of the Ducal House of Saxe- Altenburg.

evidence.title: Princess Antoinette of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: Princess Antoinette of Saxe- Altenburg( 17 April 1838 – 13 October 1908) was a princess of Saxe- Altenburg by birth and Duchess of Anhalt by marriage.

evidence.title: Princess Elisabeth Sophie of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: Elisabeth Sophie of Saxe- Altenburg( 10 October 1619 – 20 December 1680), was a princess of Saxe- Altenburg and, by marriage, duchess of Saxe- Gotha.

evidence.title: Princess Elisabeth Sophie of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: She was born in Halle, the only daughter of Johann Philipp, Duke of Saxe- Altenburg, and his wife, Elisabeth of Brunswick- Wolfenbüttel.

evidence.title: Georg Moritz, Hereditary Prince of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: George Moritz, Hereditary Prince of Saxe- Altenburg(" William George Moritz Ernest Albert Frederick Charles Constantine Edward Maximilian"; 13 May 1900 – 13 February 1991), was the last head of the ducal house of Saxe- Altenburg and nominal Duke of Saxe- Altenburg.

evidence.title: Princess Marie of Hanover
evidence.text: Princess Marie of Hanover (2 December 1849 – 4 June 1904) was the younger daughter of King George V of Hanover and of his wife, Princess Marie of Saxe-Altenburg.

evidence.title: Princess Augusta of Saxe-Meiningen
evidence.text: Princess Augusta Louise Adelaide Caroline Ida of Saxe-Meiningen (6 August 1843 – 11 November 1919) was the daughter of Bernhard II, Duke of Saxe-Meiningen and his wife Princess Marie Frederica of Hesse-Kassel.

evidence.title: Princess Augusta of Saxe-Meiningen
evidence.text: She was the mother of Ernst II, Duke of Saxe-Altenburg.

evidence.title: Ernst I, Duke of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: Ernst I, Duke of Saxe- Altenburg( German: Ernst I. Friedrich Paul Georg Nikolaus von Sachsen- Altenburg)( 16 September 1826 in Hildburghausen – 7 February 1908 in Altenburg), was a duke of Saxe- Altenburg.

evidence.title: Ernst I, Duke of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: He was the first son of Georg, Duke of Saxe- Altenburg and Marie Luise of Mecklenburg- Schwerin.

evidence.title: Ernst I, Duke of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: In 1853 he succeeded his father as Duke of Saxe- Altenburg.

evidence.title: Ernst I, Duke of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: He was of a retiring disposition and he took little active part in running the country.

evidence.title: Ernst I, Duke of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: After a reign that lasted fifty five years, he died without a living direct male heir; because of this, he was succeeded by his nephew, Ernst.

evidence.title: Prince Moritz of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: Prince Moritz Franz Friedrich Constantin Alexander Heinrich August Carl Albrecht of Saxe- Altenburg( 24 October 1829 in Eisenberg – 13 May 1907 in Arco, Italy), was a member of the ducal house of Saxe- Altenburg.

evidence.title: Prince Moritz of Saxe-Altenburg
evidence.text: He was the father of Ernst II, Duke of Saxe- Altenburg.
